title: Public editorial repair template recovery
summary: Project iteration record for limiting automatic AI repair recovery to public editorial wording failures: when every contract edit applied but the post-repair review still finds allowlisted public-copy issues, the runner now creates a fresh empty ready-gated contract template instead of blocking or inventing repair values.

validation_commands: node --test tests/unit.test.js --test-name-pattern "daily runner creates a new empty AI repair template for public editorial repair failures"

lessons.lesson: A failed repair pass is not always a hard blocker, but automatic recovery must be narrower than the general quality review loop.
lessons.evidence: The 2026-06-16 daily run needed a second public-copy edit after all first-pass contract edits applied; the failure was hot-blog editorial wording, not schema, path, source freshness, page, build, publish, or Pages verification.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep repair-review recovery limited to zero rejected edits and allowlisted public editorial task kinds, then hand Codex a new empty contract template instead of writing repair values automatically.

suggestions.issue: Runner resumed from AI repair and blocked immediately when `quality_ai_repair` returned ok=false, even if the only remaining issue was recoverable public-copy quality.
suggestions.evidence: Regression tests now cover template creation for public editorial failures, template readiness gating, and continued blocking for non-allowlisted repair-review failures.
suggestions.suggestion: Create a fresh empty `quality-ai-repair-YYYY-MM-DD-attempt-N.json` template with review summaries and bad-example comments; execute it only after a human/Codex fills edits and marks `status:"ready"`.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Scheduled daily publishing can continue through recoverable editorial repair loops without hiding real schema, factual, page, build, publish, or verification blockers.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented in daily runner state transitions, unit tests, feedback ledger, and quick-reference documentation.
validation_evidence: daily runner creates a new empty AI repair template for public editorial repair failures
daily runner does not execute AI repair template contracts until marked ready
daily runner blocks non-public-editorial AI repair review failures

followups.action: Add the durable feedback ledger item and regression tests before handing off the runner change.
